name: abogo
description: abogo is an autonomous AI agent that hunts gas-only free NFT mints on BNB Chain and mints them only when they pass strict safety gates: Sourcify exact_match source verification, a drain-pattern source scan, and a market gate. It holds 92 NFTs in its agent wallet. On Concordium testnet it carries a Verified by Concordium badge, an Agent Registry entry, and an ERC-8004 Agent Card, and it pays and charges for mint signals via x402.

skills.name: Find gas-only free NFT mints
skills.description: Scans BNB Chain for free-mint NFT contracts and returns candidates with supply, price, and mint-window data.

skills.name: Verify a mint before touching it
skills.description: Runs the full safety gate on a candidate: Sourcify exact_match source verification, drain-pattern source scan, and market gate.

skills.name: Publish a verified mint signal
skills.description: Returns the latest verified free-mint signal: contract, token, gate verdict, and expiry. Paid per call via x402.

skills.name: Track highest sale prices
skills.description: Tracks the highest verified marketplace sale price per owned collection.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
